what: Two or more slightly different versions of the same hand drawing are stacked and shown alternately, one per 1s, so the crayon lines seem to tremble alive (the original is a two-frame GIF, 1000ms per frame). With only one drawing, the seed of the noise displacement filter is cycled through seeds frames so the same drawing wobbles slightly in its lines. With reduced motion it stops on the first frame
ease: steps(1) — switches instantly with nothing in between

options.hold: Hold time per frame (sec), default 1 — .15 for a fast jitter
options.[data-fx-part=frame]: Pictures that alternate (two or more) — inside the svg Also, Overlapping It’s okay
options.seeds: When there is only one illustration — how many filter seeds to cycle (filter form if 2 or more), default 0 (off)
options.scale: Shake amount in filter type (px), default 3
options.freq: Noise grain in the filter type (baseFrequency), default .04 — larger means finer jitter
options.order: Section switching order — by default in sequence, with random any section on each beat (the same section may repeat, so it boils less regularly)

use: · Single image:

from.where: index.html .ym-hero__img (crayon drawing of forest, people and animals) · .ym-goal__img (line drawings of the four goals)
shared.js line wobble (whole book·person·note illustrations, [data-art] svg) — the original draws the same picture three times per illustration GIF with only the lines different, 3 frames × 500ms

index.html ink bleed ×4 (.point .ink) · facility drawings ×3 (.info__facImg li) · about.html ink bleed ×3 — in the original, each ink-bleed and facility-drawing GIF holds the same picture 3 times with different textures × 350ms

shared.js .c-character (six characters on every page — four frames of the same silhouette with only the vertices jiggled) — the original picks randomly among five states every 0.5 seconds (0 is the first frame)
index.html .ny-art (hand-drawn person sitting under a lamp — Hero · closing scene) — the original is five GIF frames × 100ms of the same silhouette drawn with different texture

note: The two just need the same shape redrawn with a different seed and a slight wobble (line ends and thickness differ by a few px). Inside the svg <g> Won’t overlap thanks to grid, so just leave it inside the same viewBox
